items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: but who was playing but Ben Webster was playing, and it was beautiful, smoky, and he was sounding so great, and I said that’s what I want to do.

ctx.x: For about two and a half years, we had Mike Mainieri and a few other people and Buddy. And that went very well. We just traveled around the world because he had a State

Department tour, we went to India and South America and Afghanistan and Vietnam, Nepal, just a lot of crazy places. And he had two records too, but they are kind of collector’s items on different labels. But by the way, just to backtrack, I was at Manhattan School of Music for a while, and that’s when I got the offer to go with Buddy. I think I went down to Birdland and someone said he’s looking for somebody, Seldon Powell was leaving. And I think it was my friend again, Arnold Rosen, he said, “Why don’t you get…
Really. That’s a good story, kind of that romantic, semi-funky atmosphere.
